Example transcripts — per-token emotion activation (centered across all emotions & transcripts)

Pick an arm (model × presentation) + scenario emotion + framing. Each token of the full transcript (user prompt + model response) is heat-colored by the selected emotion's probe value, double-centered (minus that emotion's all-token baseline, minus the token's mean over the 6 emotions): red = that emotion spiking above its baseline, blue = below. Switch the layer (L20 mid / L32 validity-peak / L45 late) to see where the signal lives; hover a token for its top emotions.
